topSignals.title: German EEG-Novelle/Netzpaket: Bundestag first reading held, contested Redispatch-Vorbehalt clause still undecided.
topSignals.text: The Bundestag's first reading of the EEG 2027 amendment and grid "Netzpaket" took place Sept 25 as scheduled; a Sept 26 status update confirms the outcome on the contested Redispatch-Vorbehalt grid-curtailment clause remains open, with an unusually compressed legislative timetable ahead of a likely October vote. Directly relevant to any German behind-the-meter/islanded SOFC generation model. Solarserver

topSignals.title: Priority stack check — Elcogen and Topsoe both quiet in the last 24-48h.
topSignals.text: Elcogen's most recent substantive news remains its Sept 23 SOEC whitepaper and Sept 21 Metrosert testing tie-up (already logged); nothing new since. Elcogen News, Topsoe Press Releases

topSignals.title: New peer-reviewed review frames SOFC as a "bridge asset" for AI data centers, not a permanent grid alternative.
topSignals.text: A Processes (MDPI) review by Dankook University (J. Kim), surfaced in today's paper sweep, synthesizes commercial SOFC efficiency (50-60% net electrical) and deployment scale-up (325 kW units to planned 2.45 GW projects), concluding durability and long-term cost competitiveness still favor grid expansion over SOFC as a permanent solution rather than an interconnection-delay bridge. Published Aug 13, 2026 — outside the strict 7-day window but a useful LCOE/positioning data point not previously logged. MDPI Processes 14(16):2586

Top story — see Top Signal #1:* Germany's EEG-Novelle/Netzpaket Bundestag first reading confirmed Sept 25; the contested Redispatch-Vorbehalt clause's fate is still undecided as of the Sept 26 status check, with a compressed timetable toward likely October passage. Standing background unchanged since yesterday's digest: DOE's directive for FERC to complete large-load/data-center interconnection rulemaking (deadline April 30, 2026, per the original October 2025 order); ITC 48E (30% fuel-cell credit) and 45V hydrogen credit unchanged post-OBBBA; Virginia's data-center electricity-consumption tax, New York permit moratorium, Texas development pause, and EPA turbine NSPS all as previously logged — no new developments on any of these in the last 24-48h.

Bloom Energy (BE): No incremental news since the Sept 25 Oracle-reaffirmation rally (+8% to $288.77); shares continue trading off both that catalyst and the Sept 21 S&P 500 inclusion (already logged), against the Project Jupiter permitting/pipeline overhang. Q3 earnings due Oct 27; scandium securities-suit lead-plaintiff deadline Sept 28 (imminent).

FuelCell Energy (FCEL): No new operational disclosures in the window; Nov 10, 2026 lead-plaintiff deadline (Fit Energy cost-overrun disclosure suit) still pending. Backlog remains $3.6B per the Q3 transcript.
Ceres Power (CWR.L): No new market-moving news since the Sept 17 "time-to-power" UK grid-connection whitepaper (already logged) and Sept 23 H1 results.

lcoe.text: Efficiency/positioning datapoint (new today): Kim (2026, Processes/MDPI) cites 50-60% net electrical efficiency for commercial SOFC systems and frames SOFC economics as durability-constrained relative to grid expansion over the long term — worth cross-checking against the model's own efficiency curve and lifetime cost-competitiveness assumptions. MDPI Processes
